verdict.rationale: Termius's first-party docs say Workspaces "group multiple terminal sessions into one focused environment" and let you "broadcast the same input to multiple sessions" or "broadcast a command to all sessions simultaneously." Workspaces can also be saved as reusable templates, and Snippets can run the same command on multiple hosts at once. Both halves of the story are documented directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that workspace broadcast works as described.
